group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Stevenson-Wydler Short-Form Cooperative Research & Development Agreement – Regents of the University of California - Ernest Orlando Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory – Division of Facilities Planning & Management
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of Stevenson-Wyler Short-Form Cooperative Research & Development Agreement between the Regents of the University of California, on behalf of its Ernest Orlando Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (EOLBNL), and the District, as the latter prepares to reopen its K-12 classroom, and is considering the adequacy of its current heating, ventilation and air-condition systems (HVAC) in classrooms, for EOLBNL to provide technical assistance to the District in its review of guidance and best practices for reducing aerosol transmission risk and to work with District in selecting indoor air quality (IAQ) monitors as part of longer term strategies to ensure adequate ventilation in K-12 classroom, via the Facilities Planning and Management Division, for the term of January 29, 2021, through March 31, 2021, with the District providing $0 cash and a $1,350.00 in-kind contribution and the Regents though its contract with U.S. Department of Energy (USDOE) contributing $10,000.00, subject to available funding.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Ratifies Berkeley Lab agreement to advise OUSD on classroom air quality and ventilation at no cash cost
summary: The district has a short research agreement with the University of California, on behalf of Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, as it prepares to reopen classrooms. The lab will review guidance on reducing the spread of airborne virus particles and help pick indoor air quality monitors, as the district considers whether its classroom heating and ventilation systems are adequate. The district pays $0.00 in cash and gives $1,350.00 in in-kind (non-cash) support; the university contributes $10,000.00 through its U.S. Department of Energy contract. The term began January 29, 2021, before the board's vote, and ends March 31, 2021.
vendor_name: Regents of the University of California (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory)
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Measure N Commission - February 2, 2021 Jason Gumataotao, Chairperson
title: Measure N Commission - 2020-2021 Budget Modification - Castlemont High School
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education, upon recommendation of Measure N Commission, of a 2020-2021 budget modification request from Castlemont High School transferring the total amount of $7,795.00 from two different strategic actions; Supplies & Materials (no impact, given the time left in the year and nothing has been spent so far on this action) to Consultant Contracts to hire Oakland Kids First to provide stipends for school year and summer internships, as stated in the justification section of the New or Revised Strategic Action Section of the Budget Modification Form.
presenter: Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission
headline: Moves $7,795 at Castlemont High to pay Oakland Kids First for student internship stipends
summary: Castlemont High School asked to move $7,795 within its 2020-21 Measure N budget. The money comes from its Supplies & Materials line, where nothing has been spent so far this year, and goes to Consultant Contracts so that Oakland Kids First can provide stipends for school-year and summer student internships. This is a transfer of money the school already has, not new funding.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Measure N Commission - February 2, 2021 Jason Gumataotao, Chairperson
title: Measure N Commission - 2020-2021 Budget Modification - Skyline High School
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education, upon recommendation of Measure N Commission, of a 2020-2021 budget modification request from Skyline High School transferring $13,125.00 from four different strategic actions; $5,000 from Transportation Costs, $3,125 from Teacher Substitutes, $4,000 from Transportation Costs, and $1,000 from AC Transit/BART Tickets (little to no impact- travel, field trips, conferences and substitutes not needed) to Teacher Salaries Stipends for Extended Contracts for Collaboration / PD Time, as stated in the justification section of the New or Revised Strategic Action Section of the Budget Modification Form.
presenter: Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission
headline: Moves $13,125 at Skyline High from travel and substitute budgets to teacher collaboration stipends
summary: Skyline High School asked to move $13,125 within its 2020-21 Measure N budget. The money comes from transportation, teacher substitute and AC Transit/BART ticket lines that are not needed this year because travel, field trips and conferences are not happening. It goes to stipends for teachers on extended contracts to collaborate and take part in training. This is a transfer of money the school already has, not new funding.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 4, Independent Consultant Agreement for Professional Services – Anthonio, Inc. – Glenview Elementary School New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Extends Anthonio's Glenview Elementary construction consulting agreement by a year, to Dec. 31, 2021

outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 3, Independent Consultant Agreement – Integral Group – Fremont High School New Construction Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 3, Independent Consultant Agreement for Professional Services between the District and The Integral Group, Inc., Oakland, CA, for the Fremont High School New Construction Project, authorizing additional Commissioning Services, as described in the proposal dated January 22, 2021 attached to this Amendment as part of Exhibit A, at no additional cost, extending term of Agreement from August 25, 2016 through December 31, 2020 to December 31, 2021, by 365 additional calendar days, and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Amendment for same with said Consultant. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds commissioning services at no cost and extends Integral Group's Fremont High work to Dec. 31, 2021
summary: This amendment adds commissioning services (testing that building systems work as designed) at no additional cost for the new Fremont High School building. It also extends the consulting agreement with The Integral Group, Inc. by 365 days, from December 31, 2020 to December 31, 2021. The agreement began August 25, 2016 and is paid from Measure J bond funds.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: General Services Agreement - Johnson Controls Fire Protection, LP - Fremont High School New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of General Services Agreement between the District and Johnson Controls Fire Protection, LP (“Contractor”), Livermore, CA, for the latter to provide Supervision of the Installing Contractor - Fire Prevention and Controls - for the Fremont High School New Construction Project, Increments 3, 4 & 5 for any and all Supervision work completed after 12/31/2020, in the amount of $113,123.00, as the selected Consultant, with a term of January 1, 2021, through December 31, 2021, pursuant to the Agreement.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays Johnson Controls Fire Protection up to $113,123 to oversee fire-system installation at Fremont High
summary: The district hires Johnson Controls Fire Protection, LP for $113,123.00 to supervise the contractor installing fire prevention and control systems for the new Fremont High School building. The work covers Increments 3, 4 and 5 and any supervision done after December 31, 2020. The term is January 1 to December 31, 2021, and it is paid from Measure J bond funds.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement – ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. - Glenview Elementary School New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement between the District and ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc., Oakland, CA, extending term of Agreement from December 10, 2020 through March 29, 2021 to December 31, 2021, by 277 additional calendar days, for performance of the environmental services stated in the Agreement for the Glenview Elementary School New Construction Project, and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Amendment for same with said Consultant. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Extends ACC Environmental's Glenview Elementary environmental services agreement to Dec. 31, 2021
summary: This amendment extends the district's agreement with ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. by 277 days, from March 29, 2021 to December 31, 2021, so it can finish the environmental services for the new Glenview Elementary School building. The text states no added money. The agreement began December 10, 2020, and the project is paid from Measure J bond funds.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Change Order No. 3, Lease Leaseback Agreement – Overaa/Tulum – Foster The Center Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 3, Lease-Leaseback Agreement (LLA) for the Foster The Center Project with Overaa/Tulum (“Contractor”), Richmond, CA, for the latter to provide the construction services delineated in said Charge Order for the Center New Central Kitchen, in the amount of $2,465,319.59, increasing the LLA not to exceed amount from $47,187,998.25 to $49,653,317.84, extending the current completion deadline of February 20, 2018 to February 17, 2021, an additional 361 calendar days. Approval of Change Order No. 3, LLA between the District and Overaa/Tulum/Eclipse is conditioned upon the concurrent approval of Change Orders No. 1 (21-0481) and 2 (21-0482). All other terms and conditions of the LLA remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $2.47M and about a year to Overaa/Tulum's Foster The Center kitchen construction contract
summary: This change order adds $2,465,319.59 to the lease-leaseback construction contract (the district leases the site to the builder and leases it back) with Overaa/Tulum for the new central kitchen. It raises the maximum price from $47,187,998.25 to $49,653,317.84 and moves the completion deadline to February 17, 2021. It is approved only if Change Orders 1 and 2 (items 21-0481 and 21-0482) are also approved.
source_issue: The text gives the current completion deadline as February 20, 2018 and the new one as February 17, 2021, yet calls this an additional 361 calendar days, so the stated dates and the day count conflict.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (7–0), instead of with the rest of the consent report.
outcome_action: Adopted

title: Change Order No. 1, Lease Leaseback Agreement – Overaa/Tulum – Foster The Center Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1, Lease-Leaseback Agreement (LLA) Between the District and Overaa/Tulum/Eclipse, Richmond, CA, for the latter to provide construction services which consist of extended general conditions due to schedule delays caused by Fire Alarm scope, Health Department scope, and PG&E delays for the New Central Kitchen for the Foster The Center Project, in the amount of $985,871.35, increasing the Contract not to exceed amount from $44,844,035.00 to $45,829,906.35, extending the current completion deadline of August 8, 2019 to January 31, 2020 (an additional 149 calendar days), as selected Contractor, pursuant to the Change Order. All other terms and conditions of the LLA remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $985,871 to Overaa/Tulum's Foster The Center kitchen contract for schedule-delay costs
summary: This change order adds $985,871.35 to the lease-leaseback construction contract (the district leases the site to the builder and leases it back) for the new central kitchen. The money covers extra on-site general costs caused by delays from fire alarm work, Health Department requirements and PG&E. It raises the maximum price from $44,844,035.00 to $45,829,906.35 and moves the deadline to January 31, 2020, which was before this March 2021 approval.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (7–0), instead of with the rest of the consent report.
outcome_action: Adopted

title: Change Order No. 2, Lease Leaseback Agreement – Overaa/Tulum – Foster The Center Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 2, Lease-Leaseback Agreement (LLA) Between the District and Overaa/Tulum/Eclipse, Richmond, CA, for the latter to provide construction services which includes Various PCOs for additional equipment and fencing as requested by Nutritional Service and extended site security due to schedule extension, scope to address conflicts in the CDs for the New Central Kitchen for the Foster The Center Project, in the amount of $1,358,091.90, increasing the Contract not to exceed amount from $45,829,906.35 to $47,187,998.25, extending the current completion deadline of January 31, 2020 to February 22, 2020 (an additional 22 calendar days), as selected Contractor, pursuant the Change Order. Approval of Change Order No. 2, LLA between the District and Overaa/Tulum/Eclipse is conditioned upon the concurrent approval of Change Order No. 1 (21-0481). All other terms and conditions of the LLA remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $1.36M to Overaa/Tulum's Foster The Center kitchen contract for equipment, fencing and security
summary: This change order adds $1,358,091.90 to the lease-leaseback construction contract (the district leases the site to the builder and leases it back) for the new central kitchen. It pays for added equipment and fencing requested by Nutrition Services, extra site security during the schedule extension, and fixes for conflicts in the construction drawings. It raises the maximum price from $45,829,906.35 to $47,187,998.25 and moves the deadline to February 22, 2020, before this March 2021 approval. It is approved only if Change Order 1 is also approved.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
